out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: food kept on time in the self service area
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EHS HAD PIC FILL IN DISCARD TIMES ON THE LOG.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC (4 Hour), Initial Temp of 41F or 135F
violations.observation: Observed logs that showed food was at 43-44F or 120-130F when put on time.
violations.corrective_action: PIC discarded food that was not 41F or less or 135F or higher when put on time. EHS educated employees on proper time as a public health control procedures.

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: food in the front service area kept on time
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC ADDED END POINT.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed cut cabbage on the counter at 70F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED CABBAGE.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED 3 LIVE COCKROACHES IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC WILL RECEIVE PEST CONTROL AND PROVIDE AND INVOICE WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not finished to have a smooth, cleanable surface: observed multiple pieces of non NSF equipment.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be finished to have a smooth, easily cleanable surface.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Ceasing Operations & Reporting (Voluntary for Imminent Health Hazard)
violations.observation: The permit holder failed to discontinue operations and notify the Health Department that an imminent health hazard may exist. Observed live roaches, dead roaches, mouse droppings.
violations.corrective_action: MANAGEMENT CHOSE TO SELF CLOSE UNTIL OBSERVATIONS CITED ON THIS REPORT ARE CORRECTED. MANAGEMENT WILL CALL THE EHS AT 571-585-0446 TO SCHEDULE A FOLLOW UP INSPECTION IN ORDER TO RE-OPEN.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. Staff member did not use soap.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO USE SOAP AND A HAND SINK AS REQUIRED.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in the 3-vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO WASH HER HANDS AT THE DESIGNATED HAND SINK; NO OTHER SINKS.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed raw shelled eggs sitting out at room temperature next to the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO MOVE THE EGGS TO A REFRIGERATOR IMMEDIATELY OR TO DISCARD THEM IF THEY HAD BEEN EXPOSED TO TEMPERATURE ABUSE FOR 4 HOURS OR MORE.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: 1) FOODS SITTING OUT AT ROOM TEMPERATURE FOR RETAIL SALE TO INCLUDE: A) COOKED PROTEINS, B) COOKED VEGETABLES, C) COOKED NOODLES, D) FRESH KIMCHI PRODUCTS, E) VARIETIES OF SOUPS, F) SOYBEAN SALADS, G) VARIETIES OF RICE CAKES, H) SUMMER ROLLS, I) FRIED FOODS.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT PROVIDING EITHER A SPREAD SHEET OR DRY ERASE BOARD TO INDICATE ALL TCS FOODS SITTING OUT AT ROOM TEMPERATURE. THE FOODS SHALL HAVE A START TEMPERATURE, START TIME, AND DISCARD TIME. SEE EMAILED AGREEMENT BETWEEN OWNERSHIP AND HEALTH DEPARTMENT. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. Observed cans of RAID and ORTHO home use pesticides in the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EHS EXPLAINED HOME USE PESTICIDES ARE NOT ALLOWED AND cannot BE SPRAYED BY STAFF. CONTACT YOUR LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR FOR MORE FREQUENT SERVICES BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed spray bottles of chemicals at the mop sink area that were unlabeled.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO LABEL ALL WORKING CONTAINERS OF CHEMICALS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: 1) FROZEN FOODS OBSERVED THAWING UNDER ROOM TEMPERATURE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO PROPERLY THAW FROZEN FOODS USING ONE OF THE LISTED METHODS ABOVE. ENSURE STAFF ARE TRAINED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: 1) WORKING CONTAINERS OF THE FOLLOWING: A) VINEGAR, B) OILS, C) DRY SEASONINGS IN SHAKERS, D) BULK BINS, ETC
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT ALL WORKING CONTAINERS, BOTTLES, AND BULK BINS REQUIRE LABELS DETAILING THE FOOD ITEM IN THE CONTAINER. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Observed several live roaches in multiple life stages, dead roaches on glue boards, dead roaches trapped between tape and the wall at the cook line, and mouse droppings in the kitchen areas.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO CONTACT A LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR, ELIMINATE HARBORAGE CONDITIONS, AND PERFORM A DEEP AND THOROUGH CLEANING. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed corn oil on the floor in the kitchen next to the cook line and food on the floor in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO GET ALL FOOD AND/OR BEVERAGES OFF THE FLOOR USING NSF APPROVED SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO PROVIDE BLEACH WATER BUCKETS AT WORK STATIONS FOR STORAGE OF WET TOWELS USED TO WIPE DOWN SURFACES. ENSURE THE BLEACH WATER SOLUTION IS MAINTAINED AT 50-200PPM. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Single-service items for FRESH PEELED GARLIC and GRANULATED GARCLI were observed reused for the storage of other foods and dry seasonings.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items may not be reused. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PROVIDE MORE NSF APPROVED FOOD CONTAINERS DESIGNED FOR CONTINUOUS WARE WASHING. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: 1) CARDBOARD LINING SURFACES, 2) ALUMINUM FOIL LINING COOKING EQUIPMENT.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO REMOVE AS THE MATERIALS ARE NOT CLEANABLE AND THEY CONTRIBUTE TO HARBORAGE OF INSECTS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: Observed several non-NSF approved pieces of equipment that are not designed to be easily cleanable as parts are not removed for washing, rinsing, and sanitizing.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be finished to have a smooth, easily cleanable surface. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO OBTAIN SPECIFICATION SHEETS FROM KOREA IDENTIFYING THE 7 DIFFERENT PIECES OF EQUIPMENT ARE NSF OR EQUIVALENT. IF NOT NSF OR EQUIVALENT, THE PIECES OF EQUIPMENT SHALL BE REMOVED.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: 1) EXTERIORS OF EQUIPMENT INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO: A) EXTERIORS OF BULK FOOD BINS, B) EXTERIOR OF COOK LINE EQUIPMENT, C) SHELVING UNITS, D) STORAGE UNITS, E) REFRIGERATOR/FREEZER DOOR HANDLES, F) FLOOR DRAINS AND RELATED PLUMBING, G) MINI FAN IN BACK KITCHEN AREA (COATED IN DUST), ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO PERFORM A DEEP AND THOROUGH CLEANING OF THE KITCHEN AREAS TO REMOVE ALL DUST, GREASE, FOOD DEBRIS, AND FOOD SPLATTER. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: Observed the gas water heater with only 75,100 btu’s at an 80% thermal efficiency. The unit is undersized for the hot water demands of the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Within 30 days, the permit holder shall replace or upgrade the water heater with a unit that meets the following design and capacity requirements: (1) Commercial grade, (2) Minimum of 50 gallon storage tank, (3) Minimum recovery rate of 105gph of 120fwater at a 80rise@, and (4) Specifications and installation meet National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) Standard 5. The permit holder shall provide the Health Department with the specifications (cut sheet) for the replacement water heater and obtain approval prior to purchase and installation. Please be reminded that equipment replacement or addition is not allowed without prior approval by the Health Department. EHS EMAILED MANAGEMENT THAT THE CURRENT GAS WATER HEATER IS UNDERSIZED BY 16.2%. FACILITY WILL NEED TO UPGRADE THE GAS WATER HEATER TO ACHIEVE A MINIMUM OF 105GPH OF HOT WATER. THIS MEANS THE GAS WATER HEATER SHALL BE AT LEAST 90,000 BTU’S AT 80% THERMAL EFFICIENCY OR 75,100 BTU’S AT 95% THERMAL EFFICIENCY. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the ICE MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO CALL A LICENSED PLUMBER TO ENSURE THE ICE MACHINE WAS INSTALLED WITH AN APPROVED BACK FLOW PREVENTION DEVICE ON THE WATER LINE. PROVIDE PROOF DURING THE FOLLOW UP OR HAVE THE APPROVED BACK FLOW PREVENTION DEVICE INSTALLED. ANNANDALE CATERING (Inspection Date: 01/02/2025) Page 2 of 5

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Refuse Areas & Enclosures Maintained Clean
violations.observation: Trash and litter were observed adjacent to the refuse containers and recycling bin outside the facility.
violations.corrective_action: A storage area and enclosure for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be maintained free of unnecessary items and kept clean. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO CLEAN UP THE AREA AROUND THE DUMPSTERS AND RECYCLING BINS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.observation: Outside refuse and recycling containers were either uncovered and/or doors open.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO WORK WITH THE OTHER RESTAURANTS TO ENSURE THE LIDS AND DOORS ARE CLOSED AT ALL TIMES WHEN NOT ACTIVELY DISPOSING OF TRASH AND RECYCLING. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the KITCHEN FLOOR TILES are in need of re-grouting.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT THE KITCHEN FLOOR TILES NEED TO BE RE-GROUTED TO PREVENT THE POOLING OF WATER AND FOOD DEBRIS WHICH CONTRIBUTES TO A HARBORAGE CONDITION FOR INSECTS AND/OR RODENTS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION. ANNANDALE CATERING (Inspection Date: 01/02/2025) Page 3 of 5

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: Observed improper ceiling panels in the employee restroom.
violations.corrective_action: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling must be designed, constructed and installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT THE CEILING PANELS IN THE RESTROOM SHALL BE VINYL COATED; EASILY WASHABLE. REPLACE THE CEILING PANELS AS NEEDED BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION. ANNANDALE CATERING (Inspection Date: 01/02/2025) Page 4 of 5

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the kitchen floors are in need of cleaning especially behind and underneath equipment.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PERFORM A THOROUGH CLEANING OF THE FLOORS TO REMOVE GREASE, DUST, AND FOOD DEBRIS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.
